{{Top|leg}}
{{Youmay|the swear word|the phrase [[Bantha fodder/Legends|bantha poodoo]]|linebreak=1}}
{{Quote|This is a load of poodoo, counselor!"<br /><small>''[putting her hands over Allana's ears]''</small> "Han!|Han Solo to Lestra Oxic, which Princess Leia tries to keep her granddaughter Allana from hearing|<ref name="Millennium Falcon">[[Millennium Falcon (novel)|''Millennium Falcon'']]</ref>}}
'''Poodoo''' was a [[Huttese/Legends|Huttese]] swear word.

==Description==
Poodoo was a swear word in [[Huttese/Legends|Huttese]]<ref name="TPM">{{Film|I}}</ref> commonly utilized as a slang term.<ref name="Allies">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Allies]]''</ref> It translated to [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]] as "fodder."<ref name="ROTJ">{{Film|VI}}</ref> 

The term could also be used as a term for nonsense,<ref name="Vortex">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Vortex]]''</ref> or something that a person disliked.<ref name="Legacy of the Force: Tempest">''[[Legacy of the Force: Tempest]]''</ref> The term "pile of poodoo" referred to a bunch of lies.<ref name="Star Wars 40">[[Star Wars (1998) 40|''Star Wars'' (1998) 40]]</ref>

The phrase "piece of poodoo" referred to something that was utterly worthless, while the term "little poodoo" was used as an insult aimed at another person.<ref name="Stealth">''[[Clone Wars Gambit: Stealth]]''</ref>

The term "no poodoo" was used as an expression of surprise,<ref name="Death Star">[[Death Star (novel)|''Death Star'']]</ref> while "go to poodoo"<ref name="True Colors">''[[Republic Commando: True Colors]]''</ref> and "go poodoo" meant to go awry.<ref name="Blue Shadow Virus">{{TCW|Blue Shadow Virus (episode)}}</ref> 

"Cut the poodoo" was a term used to ask someone to get to the point.<ref name="Bloodlines">''[[Legacy of the Force: Bloodlines]]''</ref> 

"In deep poodoo"<ref name="Stealth" /> and "in the poodoo" were terms for being in a lot of trouble,<ref name="Revelation">''[[Legacy of the Force: Revelation]]''</ref> while "in humpty deep poodoo" was an [[Ugnaught/Legends|Ugnaught]] term for the same thing.<ref name="Street of Shadows">''[[Coruscant Nights II: Street of Shadows]]''</ref> Similarly, the phrase "out of deep [[Ronto/Legends|ronto]] poodoo" referred to staying ''out'' of trouble.<ref name="Patterns of Force">''[[Coruscant Nights III: Patterns of Force]]''</ref>

"Full of poodoo" meant that a person was lying,<ref name="Shadow Games">''[[Shadow Games]]''</ref> while "a load of poodoo" referred to something that was not true.<ref name="Millennium Falcon" />

"Eat poodoo" was an expression of contempt toward another party,<ref name="Conquest">''[[The New Jedi Order: Edge of Victory I: Conquest]]''</ref> while "drag someone's name into the poodoo pit" referred to damaging someone's reputation.<ref name="Tempest">''[[Legacy of the Force: Tempest]]''</ref>

"Give a poodoo" meant to care about something, e.g. "why give a poodoo?"<ref name="Millennium Falcon" />

==History==
===Great Peace of the Republic===
====32 BBY====
In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], the [[Dug/Legends|Dug]] [[Podracing/Legends|podracer pilot]] [[Sebulba/Legends|Sebulba]] competed in the [[Boonta Eve Classic/Legends|Boonta Eve Classic]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], but lost control of [[Sebulba's Podracer/Legends|his podracer]] toward the end of the race and crashed into the ground. The Dug was left cursing in his damaged [[Cockpit/Legends|cockpit]], letting out an exasperated "poodoo!"<ref name="TPM" /> 

====31 BBY====
The [[31 BBY/Legends|following year]], the local criminals had made bets based on how long [[Quinlan Vos/Legends|Quinlan Vos]] would survive on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]], knowing of his [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] origins and his [[Amnesia/Legends|amnesia]]. After pretending to bring Vos to safety, [[Vilmarh Grahrk]] put his [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] to Vos's head and pulled the trigger, so that he could win the bet. At the same time, the remaining criminals who had made bets were monitoring the situation through a video transmission, and one of them articulated their frustration at the [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronian]] by shouting, "Poodoo!" However, it turned out that Vos had switched the weapon's [[Power cell/Legends|power cell]], his [[Psychometry/Legends|powers]] having forewarned him of Grahrk's betrayal. To cover his losses, the Devaronian made a new bet: that Vos would escape alive. He explained in broken [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]], "I lose and I poodoo."<ref name="Star Wars 19">[[Star Wars (1998) 19|''Star Wars'' (1998) 19]]</ref>

While investigating a local cave on [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]], Vos and Grahrk found a mass web of giant [[energy spider]] [[Egg/Legends|eggs]]; the kind found normally on [[Kessel/Legends|Kessel]], and used to make [[Glitterstim/Legends|glitterstim]]. They were soon attacked by a group of hatched [[Spider/Legends|spiders]]. Vos suggested that they should face the creatures head-on and eliminate them. However, as they engaged in battle, they found themselves struggling, leading Grahrk to comment that Vos could not "plan for poodoo."<ref name="Star Wars 21">[[Star Wars (1998) 21|''Star Wars'' (1998) 21]]</ref>

As Vos prepared to [[Death/Legends|kill]] [[Pol Secura]], Pol's niece [[Aayla Secura/Legends|Aayla Secura]] instinctively [[Telekinesis/Legends|Force-pushed]] them both off the ledge, leaving Vos hanging on the edge and sending Pol Secura plummeting to a stone platform, killing him.  As Jedi Secura rushed to her uncle, Grahrk pulled Vos up, remarking, "You drop us deep in poodoo" and explained that he would have let ''Vos'' drop too if he hadn't bet [[Currency/Legends|money]] on the Jedi getting off [[Planet/Legends|planet]].<ref name="Star Wars 22">[[Star Wars (1998) 22|''Star Wars'' (1998) 22]]</ref>

====30 BBY====
[[30 BBY|One year later]], [[Merglyn]] was attempting to [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggle]] [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]] to [[Kiffex/Legends|Kiffex]], when she was detected by the [[Kiffu Guardians]] stationed above the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. As the Guardians successfully targeted Merglyn's [[Starship/Legends|spacecraft]], she exclaimed, "Poodoo! The [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|shield generator]] light just went out!" moments before she met her end amidst the fiery destruction of the ship.<ref name="Star Wars 32">[[Star Wars (1998) 32|''Star Wars'' (1998) 32]]</ref>

Later that [[Standard year/Legends|year]], [[Zao]] was serving as a [[Chef/Legends|chef]] to the [[Aqualish/Legends|Aqualish]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Gorto Zaga]] on Kiffex. Following the presentation of a meal from Zao, Zaga erroneously assumed that a different staff member, a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Alien/Legends|alien]] who had served him, was responsible for the cooking and was attempting to [[Poison/Legends|poison]] him. He shouted in a combination of [[Aqualish (language)/Legends|Aqualish]] and [[Huttese/Legends|Huttese]], "Foodoo ''poodoo!''" The [[Parent/Legends|father]] of the girl intervened to explain that she was only responsible for serving the [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]] and had not been involved in its preparation. At that moment, Zao made his presence known, inquiring whether there was an issue with the food. Zaga ranted, "''Tu'' crear foodoo poodoo?!" Zao acknowledged his role in preparing the meal, yet he maintained that it was entirely satisfactory; it was in perfect harmony with itself, the accompanying dishes, and the universe. He confidently proposed that the issue lay with Zaga rather than the food, prompting Zaga to attempt to shoot him. However, the [[Veknoid/Legends|Veknoid]] skillfully deflected the shot using his [[Long-handle lightsaber|lightsaber staff]].<ref name="Star Wars 33">[[Star Wars (1998) 33|''Star Wars'' (1998) 33]]</ref>

While [[Alcohol/Legends|drinking]] with [[Keluda]] at the [[Cluster]] cantina on Nar Shaddaa, Grahrk related the story of how a client, "[[Palpatine/Legends|Bobo]]," sought him out as an [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] to kill Jedi. However, Keluda immediately saw right through him, dismissing the story as a "pile of poodoo."<ref name="Star Wars 40" />

====23 BBY====
In [[23 BBY/Legends|23 BBY]], Keluda tried to get the hit on [[Simon Greyshade]] after [[Tsian]] was apprehended and the [[Bounty/Legends|contract]] was officially open again. However, his efforts were thwarted by the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], leading Keluda to angrily shout, "Poodoo!"<ref name="Republic 47">[[Republic 47|''Republic'' 47]]</ref>

===Clone Wars===
====22 BBY====
In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], the Dug<ref name="AOTC">{{Film|II}}</ref> [[Seboca/Legends|Seboca]] was entertaining [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Bogg Tyrell/Legends|Bogg Tyrell]] while [[Gender/Legends|she]]<ref name="SWCL">[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2005)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']]</ref> [[Pilot/Legends|piloted]] a [[Speeder/Legends|speeder]] through the [[Skylane/Legends|skylanes]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. The pair were interrupted when Obi-Wan Kenobi nearly collided with their vehicle while hanging from the [[Assassin droid/Legends|assassin droid]] [[ASN-121/Legends|ASN-121]], forcing Tyrell to swerve. Seboca then cursed at Kenobi in Huttese as the Jedi was carried away, calling him "Jedi poodoo!"<ref name="AOTC" />

After the outbreak of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Jedi and [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] forces engaged one another during the [[Battle of Varonat]]. In the midst of the assault, [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] formulated the plan to ram the pirate vessel, murmuring "Poodoo!" to himself as he carried out the action.<ref name="Republic 62">[[Republic 62|''Republic'' 62]]</ref>

Deceived into believing that Jedi Knight Anakin Skywalker and his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] had taken his son [[Rotta/Legends|Rotta]] [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoner]], [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt]] angrily labeled the two as "Jedi poodoo,"<ref name="TCW film">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' film]]</ref> and unleashed a torrent of insults and threats in Huttese, detailing the retribution he would exact upon Skywalker upon his capture, as well as the fate that awaited any "Jedi ''poodoo''" who dared to enter [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]].<ref name="TCW novel">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (novelization)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' novelization]]</ref> When Skywalker entered [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|Jabba's Palace]] to negotiate with the Hutt, Jabba responded with anger, calling him "Jedi poodoo."<ref name="TCW film" />

Upon boarding a [[GS-100 salvage ship|Trandoshan scavenger vessel]], Skywalker and Tano were immediately greeted by an unpleasant odor as they exited the [[airlock]]. Skywalker clarified that the smell was typical of [[Trandoshan]]s and jokingly remarked that in Huttese, "Trandoshan" translated to "'snuffin poodoo."<ref name="Grievous Attacks!">''[[The Clone Wars: Grievous Attacks!]]''</ref>

====21 BBY====
Later, the [[Shaak/Legends|shaak]] herder [[Peppi Bow/Legends|Peppi Bow]] lead her herd to the banks of a river on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. Her animals proceeded to drink from the river, but began to honk and snort in alarm, before falling to the ground, [[Death/Legends|dead]]. An alarmed Bow realized that the [[Water/Legends|water]] was somehow contaminated. While trying to maneuver the remaining shaaks away from the river using her [[Electropole/Legends|electropole]], she noted, "The water gone poodoo. This is mooie bad." However, it was too late. Although only six of the animals died immediately, almost every other shaak in her herd fell ill and eventually perished.<ref name="Blue Shadow Virus" />

In their [[Mission to Iego/Legends|quest]] to find a [[Antidote/Legends|cure]] for the [[Blue Shadow Virus/Legends|Blue Shadow Virus]], Obi-Wan Kenobi and Anakin Skywalker discovered [[Reeksa/Legends|reeksa]] root, the essential component, on the planet [[Iego/Legends|Iego]]. Upon noticing the [[Carnivorous plant/Legends|carnivorous plant]], Skywalker muttered, "Oh, poodoo."<ref name="Mystery of">{{TCW|Mystery of a Thousand Moons}}</ref>

At [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|Jabba's Palace]], [[Brainee/Legends|Brainee]] and a [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]] were involved in a game of [[Chance cube/Legends|chance cubes]] with [[Greedo/Legends|Greedo]]. Following a bad roll of the dice, an irritated Greedo exclaimed, "Poodoo!"<ref name="Sphere of Influence">{{TCW|Sphere of Influence}}</ref>

On a journey from [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] to [[Lanteeb/Legends|Lanteeb]] with Obi-Wan Kenobi, Skywalker recognized the [[Starship/Legends|ship]]'s inadequate condition, calling it a "piece of poodoo." Yet, it was still a ship, and the experience of flying it brought him a sense of freedom. After his Padawan uncovered information indicating that [[damotite]] on Lanteeb might be utilized as a bioweapon, Skywalker informed [[Bail Prestor Organa|Bail Organa]] that his intuition warned him they were "in deep poodoo." While reminiscing about his time as a [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], Skywalker thought of his past owner, [[Watto/Legends|Watto]], and wondered what "the little poodoo" was doing now.<ref name="Stealth" />

[[Fi Skirata]] asked his colleague, [[Null-class Advanced Recon Commando]] [[A'den Skirata]], to consider what might have transpired if the Clone Wars had initiated five years into their training rather than ten. He noted that wars cannot be booked in advance and expressed curiosity about the ramifications had things "gone to poodoo" years earlier.<ref name="True Colors" />

====20 BBY====
When a group of [[Kage Warriors/Legends|Kage Warriors]] embarked on a [[Hovertrain/Legends|hovertrain]] with the objective of seizing the [[Pluma Sodi/Legends|cargo]] it carried, [[Dengar/Legends|Dengar]], one of the [[bounty hunter]]s assigned to protect the hovertrain, successfully repelled many of the assailants; however, he ultimately succumbed to the overwhelming force of the attackers and was thrown from the [[Train/Legends|train]], resulting in his frustrated exclamation of "Poodoo!"<ref name="Bounty">{{TCW|Bounty (episode)}}</ref>

===Imperial Era===
====18 BBY====
While reminiscing about his career as a reporter in [[18 BBY/Legends|18 BBY]], [[Den Dhur]] recalled the perilous situations he had encountered, having found himself in "humpty deep poodoo" on more than one occasion, a phrase that some of the [[Ugnaught/Legends|Ugnaughts]] on [[Drongar/Legends|Drongar]] had vividly expressed.<ref name="Street of Shadows" />

Later that year, Dhur urged [[Dejah Duare]], a [[Zeltron/Legends|Zeltron]] and fellow member of [[Whiplash]], to employ her [[Pheromone/Legends|pheromones]] on [[Jax Pavan]], as he believed this would help keep both Pavan and [[I-5YQ|I-Five]] "out of deep [[Ronto/Legends|ronto]] poodoo." However, when Duare attempted to form a relationship with Pavan, he rejected her advance, leading her to betray Pavan and his group to [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]].<ref name="Patterns of Force" />

====17 BBY====
In the [[17 BBY/Legends|year that followed]], [[Eriadu News Service]] reporter [[Eris Harro]] conducted an interview with the [[TIE pilot|Imperial pilot]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Shea Hublin]] of the [[77th Air Wing]], on the war-torn planet [[Kelrodo-Ai/Legends|Kelrodo-Ai]]. Afterward, [[Kaal (individual)|Kaal]], a member of [[Sword Squadron (Imperial)|Sword Squadron]], offered Hublin a congratulatory clap on the back, suggesting that it seemed Hublin was sincere in his belief in "that One [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]] poodoo." However, Hublin promptly clarified his stance, stating that he ''did'' "believe that poodoo." He elaborated that the local [[Kelrodoan]] [[Fara (Kelrodoan)|Fara]], designated to serve as a groom for the [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] of Sword Squadron and disliked by Kaal, was a warrior chieftain and argued that this designation suggested Fara had important contributions to make.<ref name="Guns of Kelrodo-Ai">{{InsiderCite|132|The Guns of Kelrodo-Ai (short story)|reprint=1}}</ref>

====0 BBY====
Upon receiving the news from Imperial Captain [[Nast Hoberd]] regarding his transfer to the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], [[Imperial gunner/Legends|Imperial gunner]] [[Tenn Graneet]] initially found the information perplexing. However, as the significance of the announcement became clear, he grinned and responded, "No poodoo, Cap?"<ref name="Death Star" />

As [[LE-BO2D9/Legends|Leebo]] feigned boredom with his conversations with [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]]'s [[YT-1300 light freighter|freighter]], the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']], he stated that Solo had filled the ship's [[Processor/Legends|CPU]] with "complete codswallop." When [[Dash Rendar/Legends|Dash Rendar]] didn't understand the word, Leebo admitted that he didn't even have an understanding for it in his databank, but that he thought it meant that the ''Falcon'' was "full of poodoo." While engaging in a conversation with Solo about the perils of visiting [[Prince/Legends|Prince]] [[Xizor/Legends|Xizor]]'s [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]], [[Falleen (planet)/Legends|Falleen]], Rendar stated that the old saying "what you don't know can't hurt you" was "total poodoo," as what you didn't know ''could'' hurt you, but knowing it wouldn't hurt any less.<ref name="Shadow Games" />

Shortly afterward, [[holostar]] [[Javul Charn]] recited her official biography to her road manager [[Kendara Farlion|Dara Farlion]], which stated that she was born in the lightless sublevels of Coruscant, and grew up with predatory gangs shooting up in the neighborhood. Farlion was quick to remind her that this was "all poodoo," adding that she found it insulting that their PR manager thought an "Imperial Center Slum" was somehow more respectable than Tatooine.<ref name="Shadow Games" />

===New Republic Era===
====8 ABY====
In [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]], the [[Squib/Legends|Squibs]] trio of [[Emala]], [[Sligh]], and [[Grees]] "helped" Han Solo and Princess [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] during their skirmishes on Tatooine while trying to obtain the [[Moss painting/Legends|moss painting]] ''[[Killik Twilight]]''. As Sligh contacted Solo over the [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]] at one point, Solo wondered if the Squibs, naturally obsessed with haggling and deal-making, were coming to say thanks. However, Sligh retorted, "Say thanks? What the poodoo for?"<ref name="Tatooine Ghost">''[[Tatooine Ghost]]''</ref>

===Yuuzhan Vong War===
====26 ABY====
During the [[Invasion of Yavin 4|assault on the Jedi Praxeum]] in [[26 ABY/Legends|26 ABY]], [[Remis Vehn]] piloted one of the [[Peace Brigade]]'s transports that participated in the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]-seeking raid on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]]. During the confusion of the initial attack, his craft was commandeered by [[Anakin Solo]]. Vehn proposed to assist in operating the guns; however, Solo responded by expressing his lack of trust in him. In turn, Vehn requested that Solo utilize his "poodoo-stinking [[Force power/Legends|Jedi powers]]" to confirm his sincerity.<ref name="Conquest" />

Shortly afterward, Jedi Knight [[Swilja Fenn]] was caught by Peace Brigadiers and transported to [[Warmaster]] [[Tsavong Lah]], who asked her to help deliver [[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]] to him. When she refused, instructing him to "eat poodoo," he laughed and turned her over to interrogators.<ref name="Conquest" />

===Second Galactic Civil War===
====40 ABY====
Following the capture of [[Ailyn Vel]] during a raid by the [[Galactic Alliance Guard]] in [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]], she underwent interrogation by [[Lon Shevu]]. Shevu remained calm but firm during questioning, telling Vel to "cut the poodoo" and tell him why she was on Coruscant.<ref name="Bloodlines" />

Serving as the personal [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] of [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] Jacen Solo during the [[Second Galactic Civil War]], the [[Imperial II-class Star Destroyer/Legends|star destroyer]] [[Anakin Solo (starship)|''Anakin Solo'']] was named after Solo's [[Death/Legends|deceased]] brother. [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]] and Han Solo, still stewing over Anakin Solo's death, made complaints in colorful vocabulary on the name of the ''Anakin'', with Jaina being furious that Jacen "would drag our little brother's name into the poodoo pit with him."<ref name="Tempest" />

====41 ABY====
The [[41 ABY|following year]], Shevu was approached by [[Ben Skywalker]] to investigate Jacen Solo, now secretly [[Darth Caedus]], together. Shevu recognized that Skywalker was in trouble; however, Skywalker retorted that it was Jacen who was in peril. Raising his eyebrows, Shevu simply responded, "Oh, that's okay, then. We're ''all'' in the poodoo."<ref name="Revelation" />

===Galactic Alliance era===
====44 ABY====
In [[44 ABY]], after the resolution of the Second Galactic Civil War, the holosigns at the [[New Balosar]] [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] conveyed the sentiment, "[[Nataasi Daala]] is [[Chief of State (Galactic Alliance)|Chief of State]], so why give a poodoo?"<ref name="Millennium Falcon" /> 

Immediately afterward, Han Solo's freighter, the ''Millennium Falcon'', was stolen on [[Vaced]], but its theft-prevention systems returned it to the spaceport. [[Lestra Oxic]], serving as legal counsel to Solo and his wife, Princess Leia Organa, offered a plea deal for joyriding and misuse of personal property, reminding the Solos that to make any further charges stick, they would have to devote much of their time to a trial. Upon hearing this, Solo shouted, "This is a load of poodoo, counselor!" Upon hearing her husband's use of the vulgar term "poodoo," Organa exclaimed, "Han!" while instinctively covering the [[Ear/Legends|ears]] of their granddaughter [[Allana Djo Solo|Allana]], even though both husband and wife were laughing heartily.<ref name="Millennium Falcon" />

While on [[Klatooine/Legends|Klatooine]] chaperoning [[Vestara Khai]] and Ben Skywalker while they purchased supplies, [[Dyon Stadd]] succumbed to [[Force psychosis|Abeloth's influence]] and consequentially went on a rampage. As they defended themselves from [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] fire, Skywalker urged Khai not to use her "dark side poodoo." Khai, unfamiliar with the slang term, replied that she would take any action required to stop the crazy [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-user]], "even dark side poodoo." This led Skywalker to burst out laughing, realizing that Khai was unaware of the term's meaning.<ref name="Allies" />

During a conversation regarding the ineffectiveness of [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Kenth Hamner]]'s negotiations with Chief of State Daala, Solo expressed to his wife that the most effective approach to handle Daala was to exclude her from the equation. He urged Organa not to give him "any poodoo" about this course of action being premature.<ref name="Vortex" />

Immediately afterward, their granddaughter Allana discovered a hidden catacomb deep within the [[New Jedi Temple]] where [[Dordi]], [[Tesar Sebatyne]], [[Wilyem]] and [[Zal]] had made a nest for their spawn. Gasping at the awful odor coming from inside the nest, Allana exclaimed, "[[Stang/Legends|Stang]]! What is that poodoo?"<ref name="Vortex" />

At the same time, [[Ysa'i]], one of the [[Doctor/Legends|doctors]] who helped care for [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Nek Bwua'tu]] after an [[attempted assassination of Admiral Nek Bwua'tu|assassination attempt]] on the Admiral left him in a [[Coma/Legends|coma]], Daala asked the doctor when Bwua'tu would awake. Ysa'i claimed that comas were not his level of expertise, but Daala warned him that now would be a very bad time to "put a plate of poodoo" in front of her.<ref name="Vortex" />

The Squib trio of Emala, Sligh, and Grees met up with the Solos in order to divulge deposed Chief of State Daala's whereabouts in exchange for [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] and safety from their [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial]] pursuers. The Squibs carried out their end of the bargain, but when they met [[Head of State (Imperial Remnant)|Imperial Head of State]] [[Jagged Fel]] to ask for amnesty, Solo and his wife became suspicious, as they noticed that the [[Alien/Legends|alien]] trio looked younger than they were when they first met. The Squibs tried to explain it away, but Solo was not persuaded by their claims of "clean living" and engaging in virtuous acts, and retorted, "That's poodoo." The alien trio were forced to reveal that they had also stolen an [[Unidentified droch serum|Imperial chemical]] that reversed aging.<ref name="Ascension">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Ascension]]''</ref>

At the same time, during a conversation over subpar [[Caf/Legends|caf]] with [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]], Daala expressed her intention to ensure that, upon regaining power, the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] would possess the capability to brew a quality cup of caf. Fett snorted, saying that as long as it kept him sharp, it could "taste like poodoo" for all he cared.<ref name="Ascension" />

Later that [[Standard year/Legends|year]], [[Abeloth]] brought Skywalker and Khai to the [[Font of Power]] so they could drink from it and become the new [[Son/Legends|Son]] and [[Daughter/Legends|Daughter]], recreating the family of Ones who would reshape [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] in their image. Vestara was tempted to drink in hopes that their new forms would enable them to defeat Abeloth but Ben convinced her otherwise. As Abeloth withdrew into the fog, Skywalker assured Khai that they could overcome the challenges ahead if they remained resolute and united. In contrast, Khai understood their limitations and retorted that this was "a load of poodoo."<ref name="Apocalypse">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Apocalypse]]''</ref>

At the same time, during the [[assault on the New Jedi Temple]], Organa and Solo piloted the ''Millennium Falcon'' to Coruscant, only to find that their granddaughter Allana, for whom they served as legal guardians, had stowed away on the freighter. Organa informed Allana that she had much to explain, to which Allana retorted that she had already provided an explanation, but they had not listened. When Solo remarked that they were not required to listen because they were her [[Parent/Legends|parents]], Allana countered, "That's a bunch of poodoo," reminding her grandfather of his frequent assertion that one should not allow others to dictate their actions.<ref name="Apocalypse" />

===Legacy era===
====137 ABY====
When [[Jariah Syn]] launched an attack against Jedi Knight [[Rasi Tuum]] in an attempt to avenge his father's death, the [[Cathar/Legends|Cathar]] Jedi Master was able to subdue him. Tuum then explained the true circumstances of [[Zareb Syn]]'s death and the rationale behind his actions against the [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]]. He encouraged Syn to search his own feelings, suggesting that he would find the truth in what he said. Syn, however, rejected this perspective, referring to it as "Jedi poodoo" and emphasizing that he was not a Jedi.<ref name="Legacy 26">[[Legacy (2006) 26|''Legacy'' (2006) 26]]</ref>

While undertaking a [[Mission to Napdu|mission]] to transport [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] refugees from a [[Moon/Legends|moon]] orbiting [[Da Soocha]], [[Anj Dahl]] and [[Hondo Karr]] utilized a civilian ship to make contact with [[Azzim Anjiliac Atirue|Azzim]] on [[Napdu]], as the rest of [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] waited, merely a quick [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] jump from Da Soocha. Growing impatient, [[Andurgo]] exclaimed in frustration, "Poodoo! Andurgo hate waiting!" Dahl then took the opportunity to explain to him that he was unable to go to Napdu, as he was who he was.<ref name="Legacy 41">[[Legacy (2006) 41|''Legacy'' (2006) 41]]</ref>

====138 ABY====
At a later time, Andurgo overheard Dahl lauding Syn's skills in piloting and exclaimed, "Poodoo! Could fly better than that with my butt!" [[Ronto (Klatooinian)|Ronto]], his colleague, jokingly commented that he had always assumed this was how Andurgo operated a craft.<ref name="Legacy War 2">[[Legacy — War 2|''Legacy — War'' 2]]</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|When they got me to say. "Poodoo," I burst out laughing. I said, "Poodoo? What does that mean?" and George said, "Well you can't say the real-world word." Which is a shame!|[[Lewis MacLeod]], the voice of [[Sebulba/Legends|Sebulba]] in ''Star Wars'' Episode I: ''The Phantom Menace''|<ref name="Best of">"Sebulba: Lewis Macleod", [[The Best of Star Wars Insider Volume 2|''The Best of Star Wars Insider'' Volume 2]]</ref>}}
A common misconception is that "poodoo" refers to feces,<ref name="Blog">{{Blog|abelgpena|5|A Mouth Like An Intergalactic Princess: Cussing In A Galaxy Far, Far Away}}</ref> even though the word is actually [[Huttese/Legends|Huttese]] for "fodder."<ref name="ROTJ" /> Despite this, the use of the term is similar to the real-world impolite word "shit," especially when used in phrases like:
